shape: gen3 contact-flag divergence: two moves make contact in gen3 that do not in the base data the engine is built from
was: reports/c88 sub-shape C, filed NOT YET DETERMINED

the_boundary.protocol: Rayquaza uses Overheat on Sharpedo; Sharpedo faints; Showdown then emits |-damage|p1a: Rayquaza|189/262|[from] ability: Rough Skin|[of] p2a: Sharpedo
the_boundary.miss: observed_only=[('abilityroughskin', -16)] engine_only=[] -- the engine emits nothing

the_reference.rough_skin: data/mods/gen3/abilities.ts:162-169 overrides roughskin to source.baseMaxhp / 16. Base (modern) is /8. The engine already has the gen3 value.
the_reference.the_actual_cause: data/mods/gen3/moves.ts:470-473 overrides OVERHEAT's flags to { contact: 1, protect: 1, mirror: 1, metronome: 1 }. Base overheat (data/moves.ts) has flags { protect, mirror, metronome } and NO contact. So in gen3 Overheat makes contact and Rough Skin fires.

the_engine.rough_skin: src/gen3/abilities.rs:193 implements ROUGHSKIN correctly -- maxhp/16, attacker's maxhp, gated on damage_dealt > 0 && choice.flags.contact. The ability is not the problem.
the_engine.the_gap: src/choices.rs builds OVERHEAT from the BASE flag set, with no contact. So choice.flags.contact is false and the ability hook never fires.

exhaustive_enumeration.method: diff every gen3 moves.ts override carrying contact:1 against the same move in base data/moves.ts
exhaustive_enumeration.verified_in_engine: choices.rs has contact absent for both OVERHEAT and ANCIENTPOWER (control: TACKLE has contact true)

disposition.the_fix: add contact to OVERHEAT and ANCIENTPOWER in the gen3 build. Bounded and exhaustively enumerated -- exactly two moves, verified against the reference rather than sampled.
disposition.blast_radius_warning: contact is not only Rough Skin. It also gates Static, Poison Point, Flame Body, Effect Spore, Cute Charm, Rocky Helmet-likes and King's Rock in some generations. Adding it changes behaviour anywhere those interact, so this needs the same measured treatment C87 got -- branch counts, the tactics gate, and a check that no currently-matched row becomes divergent.

note_on_size: one row in this 200-game window, so by rows x search-impact it ranks below the matcher shapes. Recorded now because the cause is fully established and the enumeration is exhaustive; the fix can be scheduled on its merits.
